_comment: Country risk lists used by the corridor engine. FATF publishes these three times a year (February, June, October plenaries) and has no machine-readable feed: update by hand from fatf-gafi.org after each plenary and record the date. EU list: Annex to Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/1675 as amended (consolidated text on EUR-Lex). Verified 2026-09-13.

fatf_call_for_action.source: FATF, High-Risk Jurisdictions subject to a Call for Action, plenary of 17-19 June 2026

fatf_increased_monitoring.source: FATF, Jurisdictions under Increased Monitoring, plenary of 17-19 June 2026 (22 jurisdictions; Bosnia and Herzegovina and Iraq added, Algeria and Namibia removed). Next plenary: October 2026.

eu_high_risk_third_countries.source: Annex to Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/1675, consolidated 29 January 2026 (amended by Delegated Regulations (EU) 2026/46 and 2026/83). Points I-IV.
